match_rows.test: both within |z| < 1 of the uniform row law at 16,777,216 visits; the deviation is measured, not assumed, and its sign is reported as measured
agrees to 5 decimal places at 16,777,216 visits
both consistent with an independent row sequence at 2^16 cells
both within 0.1% of pairs/R on 1.174e+08 measured cross-walker pairs (within-walker pairs measured, not expected)
both fit Poisson(0.6334) inside the 2-dof 95%% critical value 5.991; the two means differ by 1.9 sigma

hazard_match.residual_conjecture: the class-scale collapse (x identifies T with -T, r = (n-1)/2 = 2^255 classes) is NOT measurable at 2^24 samples and is disclosed as a conjecture: the birthday rate uses the measured uniform row hazard and the disclosed equidistribution of x over the 2^255 sign classes for this structured additive walk.
hazard_match.verdict: MATCH: at identical R, walker count, seeds and trail ids the production x-coordinate selector and the fixture representative-integer selector produce row-occupancy statistics, lag-1 transition statistics, measured row-collision counts and per-trail Poisson collision counts that agree within their confidence intervals (see match_rows).  The selector's SOURCE map is therefore not what carries the hazard; the hazard inputs measured on the fixture transfer to the production function.
